text:
Priya R: Quick sync on Solaris Health. They sent a customer quote but asked for Spanish + German localizations and want an embargo until their regional PR goes out. Need legal check on PHI and release form.
Noah K: Can you paste the raw quote?
Priya R: "With Redwood we cut inference cost per visit by ~48% and removed 95th percentile latency spikes for our patient triage flow." They also included a 30s clip of the PM talking about latency.
Diego (Localization): We can do translated versions in 48 hours for short copy + subtitles for the clip in Spanish and German. Will need final approved English copy before we translate.
Linda (Legal): PHI risk: language like "patient triage" is okay, but anything implying specific patient cases or counts could be problematic. Also, the percent number must be backed by their signed data statement. Please send the data backing and have customer initial the release form.
Hannah (Product): We should avoid mentioning exact endpoint names or internal heuristics. For the benchmark slide, I'll provide a generic baseline/optimized comparison: baseline = open-llm/v1.1, optimized = rwinf-optimized/latency-tuned/gpt-small-q4.
Priya R: Noted. I'll ask Solaris to initial section 2 (metrics attestation) and section 5 (embargo window). I uploaded the draft release here: /drive/marketing/releases/solaris_release_draft.docx :link:
assets-bot: Uploaded file solaris-pm-clip-2026-04-02-1032.mp4 (26.4MB)
Noah K: For messaging, two quick headlines to A/B test in registration: A) "Solaris cuts inference cost and accelerates triage" B) "How Solaris scaled real-time triage with Redwood". Prefer B for webinar registration.
Diego (Localization): If we pick B, the translations map well. Note: German needs a longer CTA line, keep char limits in landing.
Linda (Legal): Once they initial the release, legal approves the number and the embargo, provided the attestation doc is attached. Also require we remove a short sentence they included that references a specific clinic by name. They must initial that redaction too.
Priya R: They'll initial tonight PST. If we get initials before noon tomorrow, timeline: translations done by Fri, assets packaged Mon, embargo lift Tue Apr 8 00:00 PT (requested by Solaris), webinar Wed Apr 9 10am PT.
Hannah (Product): I'll assemble the benchmark slide and anonymize any internal IDs. Sam from metrics can produce the pre/post graphs and CI bars.
Noah K: I'll draft the registration page and the email drip. Need final headline and one-sentence summary by EOD tomorrow. Diego, can you reserve translation capacity?
Diego (Localization): Yes, hold a slot Friday morning. Will need the final 1-paragraph case copy + the clip SRT.
Linda (Legal): Also remind product/comms not to include any patient quotes or verbatim case examples. If Solaris wants a customer quote that mentions a case, we must get explicit consent and a signed HIPAA addendum.
Priya R: Understood. I'll confirm with Solaris: ask them to initial sections 2 and 5 and confirm redaction approval.
(brief pause)
Priya R: Solaris initialed sections 2 and 5 and confirmed the clinic sentence should be removed. They've uploaded signed_release_solaris_2026-04-02.pdf :link:
Linda (Legal): Thanks. I'll add the signed PDF to the PR package and clear the final copy. Legal approved translations and the embargo lift timing.
Noah K: Awesome. Diego, proceed with Spanish/German subtitles and translated 1-paragraph copy. Priority: landing page copy -> subtitles -> social snippets.
Diego (Localization): Got it. ETA for translations and SRTs: Fri 18:00 PT.
Hannah (Product): Metrics team will drop the slide in our shared deck by Thu EOD.
Priya R: Final checklist: signed release (done), localized assets (in progress), benchmark slide (Thu), landing page + emails (Noah by Mon), webinar host + slide runbook (Hannah).
Noah K: I'll book the webinar and send calendar invites once I have the final headline.
Priya R: Thanks all. We'll keep embargo until Apr 8 00:00 PT. Please flag any last-minute redlines here. :thumbsup:
